hook: SCP-2078 is a political memetic hazard: a presidential candidate who may not exist, spread through ads and word of mouth. It opens like satire of campaign culture and slides steadily into body horror. The closing transcript of a campaign video is the centerpiece, and it is stomach-turning in a very physical way.
whyItMatters: It shows how far a memetic article can go by borrowing a familiar format, here the soft campaign spot with piano music, farmland and an applauding crowd. The containment section is just as pointed, with a task force that may never be more than 49% American and agents planted inside election bodies. Because only people who see themselves as US citizens can catch it, national identity itself becomes the route of infection.
thingsToNotice:
The platform reads as a joke at first: a four-child minimum for married couples, defense and welfare cut to subsidize food, a constitutional ban on vegetarianism. The behaviour section shows where it leads, with infectees who never feel full gathering in groups of up to about two hundred to eat nonstop in filth for up to a week, disease spreading, and the dead burned.

The ad plays it straight until it doesn't. The children feeding chickens vanish between shots, leaving one bird with scraps of cloth in its claws, and the speech drifts from 'people power' into a vision of naked, swollen Americans crammed together in a dark, sour room, feeling one another's sweat and fat. The fine print about smelling fat burn from your bones and a last question about how beautiful that would be close the video.
